set.body:
Problem: DesignMatrixRaster.scala:91-95 hard-codes rust (181,96,55), blue (63,108,143), nuisance grey (65,82,76) and paper (248,249,247); build(review, maximumCells) (:68) takes no palette. Dark themes and caller design tokens are impossible without recolouring pixels from DesignReview.scaled.

Consumer need: the studio design sheet uses token colours in light and dark (spec section 2.3; visual contract).

Acceptance:
- A typed palette (positive, negative, nuisance, paper) parameter; the default reproduces today's pixels byte-for-byte (golden test).
- A custom palette changes colour only; column ids, scaling and scene identity unchanged; JVM+JS tests.

Out of scope: per-class colour scales (Intaglio).
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 against ScalaFIM main ea6fe3ad for the PLS Neuro model studio (plsneuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F; spec docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and GRAMMAR-NEEDS.md on plsneuro main).
set.title: Accept a palette for DesignMatrixRaster
